contract.human_inputs: Class-agnostic depth geometry candidate tracks, causal odometry, no simulator human state
contract.history: 20 queries at 10Hz; missing observations are zero with valid=false; no backward filling
contract.track_frame: estimated robot anchor frame via causal odometry ZOH; coordinates are estimates, no GT correction
contract.association_role: GT-side geometric diagnostic only; not semantic person-detector acceptance
contract.bev_target: Observed future occupancy from actual depth, warped into true robot anchor axes using simulator ego poses LABEL ONLY
contract.bev_target_excludes: No complete-world occupancy, no unseen-area completion, no persona or social-space cost
contract.bev_cell_loss_valid: Per-cell target != unknown, additionally require depth and GT pose temporal support
contract.bev_time_frame: Source depth at selected future measurement stamp; all targets frozen at anchor SE2 frame
contract.input_bev: Current depth warped to estimated anchor using only causal odometry; ZOH timing residual retained
contract.alignment_caveat: Input odom delta can differ from label GT delta; no oracle in inputs
contract.mask_policy: Original sealed bundle unchanged; all training/semantic/association acceptance stays false in pilot
contract.persona: H1-H5 schema retained, not validated or inferred from posture
contract.holdout: HuNavSim reserved for final test; no tuning/train
contract.acceptance: Geometry/timing/source-integrity tests can pass while perception readiness fails
